abstract.p: We present Oath Breakers, our system for SemEval-2025 Task 06: Promise Verification in ESG (Environmental, Social, and Governance) texts (Chen et al., 2025) which aims to identify and verify promises made within company reports. We fine-tune microsoft/deberta-v3-base with a contrastive loss to better separate promise vs. non-promise embeddings, and apply generative augmentation via Mistral-7B-Instruct-v0.3-manually validated-to balance the timeline classes. On the English official test set, we achieved F1=0.6003 (33% split, 3rd place) and F1=0.5733 (67% split, 2nd place), making our final ranking 2nd place on the English test dataset. These results validate the effectiveness of combined contrastive and generative strategies in promise verification.
